title: On a higher-integrability estimate for Laplacians of convex solutions to the Monge-Ampère equation
summary: A maximum principle for certain strictly convex functions belonging to $W^{2,1}_{\rm loc}(Ω)\cap C^1(Ω)$ is established and then applied to obtain a $W^{2,1 +\eps}_{\rm loc}(Ω)$-estimate.
